title: Core spreading of preconnected fibres for a pointed clopen piece
statement:
theorem exists_open_preconnected_fibres_of_pointed_clopen_core {P T : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : P ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (σ : T ⟶ P) (hσ : σ ≫ g = 𝟙 T) (y : T) (V : Set T) (A : Set P)
    (hV : IsOpen V) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (hA : IsClopen {q : g ⁻¹' (V ∩ closure {y}) | (q : P) ∈ A})
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (g ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A)) (hpoint : σ y ∈ A) :
    ∃ U : Set T, IsOpen U ∧ y ∈ U ∧
      ∀ t ∈ U ∩ closure {y}, IsPreconnected (g ⁻¹' {t} ∩ A)

proof.text: Construct the integral model, its open embedding into the closure of y, its fibre homeomorphisms, and the generic rational point. No connectedness is used in this construction.

Transfer preconnectedness along the generic fibre homeomorphism. The rational point supplies nonemptiness, hence connectedness. Apply the proved connected-rational-point criterion to obtain geometric connectedness of the generic fibre.
Apply generic geometric connectedness spreading. This gives an open W in the integral model base containing the generic point and geometric connectedness of every fibre over W.

The image j(W) is open in closure {y}; express it as the inverse image of an ambient open U in T. The generic point maps to y, so y belongs to U. For t in U intersect closure {y}, choose s in W with j(s)=t. Geometric connectedness implies connectedness of the model fibre. Transfer this along its fibre homeomorphism and then forget nonemptiness to get preconnectedness of g inverse image {t} intersect A.

proof_origin.note: The integral model and final ambient-open transport are fully proved. Only the general generic geometric connectedness spreading theorem is postponed.
